title: Takes forever to heat up
text:
Takes forever to heat up. I have had this for a few months now to see how it works. Not so good. It is space saving, but that is about it.
Does not toast even. Very slow to heat and forget baking anything. Just to heat up a slice of pizza takes about 15 minutes.
Not happy at all with this.

product_metadata.title: Maxi-Matic ETO-113 Elite Cuisine 2-Slice Toaster Oven with 15 Minute Timer, White
features: 15 minute timer with auto shut off and ready bell signal
Includes tempered glass door bake pan and wire rack
Power indicator light and runs at 650 watts
Measurements: Inside: 9.75” x 5” x 4.5” Outside: 13.25” x 5.25” x 6.5”
description: Stay toasty with the Elite Cuisine 2 Slice Toaster Oven. Toast bagels and bread, bake a personal pizza, or broil an open-faced sandwich. With an adjustable timer and heat selector functions, cooking is fast and easy. Bake, broil and toast settings all come with a 15 minute timer with auto shut off and ready bell signal. The Toaster has a tempered glass door and power indicator light. The Toaster includes a bake pan and wire rack. Powered at 650 watts. With its compact design, cleanup and storage is simple and hassle-free. The attractive white finish makes this toaster oven the perfect addition to any kitchen.
